sources.title: Evaluating Foveated Frame Rate Reduction in Virtual Reality for Head-Mounted Displays
sources.snippet: Foveated rendering methods usually reduce spatial resolution in the periphery of the users' view. However, using foveated rendering to reduce temporal resolution, i.e., rendering frame rate, seems less explored. In this work, we present the results of a user study investigating the perceptual effects of foveated temporal resolution reduction, where only the temporal resolution (frame rate) is reduced in the periphery without affecting spatial quality (pixel density).
